content: {"summary":"In the January 2026 data‑volume alarm on kafka‑03, the two biggest topics were `ledger.entries` and `notifications.outbound`; `ledger.entries` retains 14 days and cannot be trimmed without finance sign‑off, while `notifications.outbound` retention was temporarily reduced and can be trimmed further.","likely_cause":"Large retained data from `ledger.entries` (14‑day audit retention) together with the default 7‑day retention of `notifications.outbound` filled the Kafka data directory on kafka‑03.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"The large topics on kafka‑03 were `ledger.entries` and `notifications.outbound`.","evidence_ids":["INC-0120#0"],"quote":"Two topics stand well clear of the rest: `ledger.entries` and `notifications.outbound`."},{"text":"`ledger.entries` retains 14 days and cannot be trimmed without finance sign‑off.","evidence_ids":["INC-0120#0"],"quote":"`ledger.entries` keeps 14 days for audit, twice the broker default ... shortening it needs sign‑off from finance ops."},{"text":"`notifications.outbound` retention was reduced to one day and can be trimmed further.","evidence_ids":["INC-0120#1"],"quote":"set `retention.ms=86400000` on `notifications.outbound`: one day, no restart needed."}],"next_checks":["Check current retention settings for `notifications.outbound`","Confirm finance approval before changing `ledger.entries` retention","Monitor partition sizes after any retention change","Verify consumer lag for `notification-worker` before further trimming"]}
